decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. By utilizing cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base, allowing for quick and decisive victories. The deck also has some resilience with cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death, providing ways to protect and recur key threats. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Leyline Binding early in the game. It also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six for control and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while quickly assembling its own powerful board presence through creative combos. Additionally, there are versatile removal spells like Prismari Command and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats, making the deck adaptable to different situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty as early as possible. It also incorporates combo pieces like Wrenn and Six, Dwarven Mine, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maximize its potential. With a mix of removal spells and disruptive cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to control the board while setting up its game-winning combos. The mana base includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent performance and the ability to cast the spells needed for victory.

The deck focuses on using the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Wurmcoil Engine. It also utilizes cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to find and assemble the UrzaTron lands efficiently. Control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone help to disrupt opponent's strategies, while cards like Relic of Progenitus and Warping Wail provide additional utility. The deck aims to control the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.

The main focus of the Esper Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board control through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan, protect its own threats, and eventually win the game through incremental advantage and powerful finishers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon. By utilizing a mix of reactive spells and efficient threats, Esper Control seeks to outlast the opponent and dictate the pace of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to swap out tokens created by Dwarven Mine for big creatures like Archon of Cruelty in order to disrupt and overwhelm the opponent. It also includes various control elements like Spell Pierce and Prismari Command to protect the combo and control the game. The deck aims to surprise opponents with its unique and creative approach to generating powerful threats and disrupting the opponent's plans.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to continuously cast spells from the graveyard, fueling powerful combos with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. It aims to quickly assemble key pieces while disrupting the opponent's strategy with counter spells and removal. The deck's streamlined design and efficient card selection tools allow for consistent and explosive plays, creating a highly synergistic and aggressive game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply early pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to close out the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with aggressive threats while using cards like Grief and Blackcleave Cliffs to maintain tempo advantage. Additionally, cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional ways to protect and recur key creatures in order to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and powerful instant/sorcery spells to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. By combining disruptive countermagic with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while dealing consistent damage with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. Additionally, cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help to filter through the deck and find key cards quickly. Blood Moon is included as a way to disrupt opponents' mana bases and gain an advantage.

The key strategy of this Combo - Hammer Time deck is to quickly assemble powerful equipment like Colossus Hammer and Hammer Time onto creatures like Puresteel Paladin and Ornithopter. By utilizing cards such as Stoneforge Mystic and Sigarda's Aid, the deck aims to create explosive turns where the equipped creature can deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes synergistic cards like Steelshaper's Gift and Cranial Plating to further strengthen the equipment theme. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive combo strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It uses various color-fixing artifacts like Chromatic Sphere and Star, along with Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings to find pieces of the Tron. The deck then aims to control the game using powerful planeswalkers like Karn Liberated and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, along with removal and board wipes like Oblivion Stone. The deck can also utilize Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opponents' artifacts and combo pieces.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and utilizing Primeval Titan to search for powerful lands and combo pieces. Cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove help ensure the lands come into play untapped, allowing for explosive plays. By efficiently tutoring for key lands with cards like Tolaria West and Expedition Map, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus, backed up by lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion for additional synergy and win conditions.

The deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to pressure the opponent while efficiently removing threats with Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to control the game and protect its creatures. Mishra's Bauble helps with card selection and cantrips like Expressive Iteration and Consider provide card advantage. The deck aims to maintain tempo and card advantage to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Wrenn and Six to create a powerful combo with Archon of Cruelty and Persist to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect the combo pieces and maintain tempo. The deck also utilizes Prismari Command and Prismatic Ending for removal and disruption. Overall, the deck emphasizes creativity in its combo plays and synergies to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The key focus of this UR Aggro Modern deck is utilizing efficient spells and creatures to apply consistent pressure on the opponent, aiming to quickly reduce their life total to zero. The deck includes versatile instant and sorcery cards like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat to disrupt the opponent's game plan while utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to deal direct damage. The deck also includes card selection and filtering spells like Expressive Iteration and Consider to maintain a high level of consistency and potency in its aggressive strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces necessary to generate a large amount of mana, then use that mana to cast spells like Goblin Charbelcher and Recross the Paths to deal a massive amount of damage to the opponent in one turn. The deck focuses on efficient mana generation and manipulation through cards like Pyretic Ritual, Manamorphose, and Desperate Ritual, while also including powerful cards like Pact of Negation for protection. The deck does not rely on traditional lands, instead using cards like Turntimber Symbiosis and Valakut Awakening to find additional resources.
